text:
maya: quick sync 1: rolling out rwdv8-quant4v2 to chat and rerank for a tiny canary. want to validate versioning semantics and automated safety bailouts before any wider promote.
eric: 👍 what's different vs rwdv7-quant4?
maya: main diffs: remapped positional embeddings, updated kv-cache packing (saves memory), and a tighter topk+temp mix in sampling. Perf looks good locally but we saw a small rerank F1 dip in unit eval.
sofia: we should gate on rerank-precision AND user-visible mrr. propose an aggregated risk index so we can make a deterministic autofallback decision.
maya: draft risk index: ```
# risk_index (informal)
risk_index = 0.5 * max(0, -MRR_pct_change) + 0.35 * safety_alert_rate_delta + 0.15 * clamp((p95_latency_ms - baseline_p95)/baseline_p95, 0, 1)
# where MRR_pct_change is negative when model degrades; safety_alert_rate_delta is absolute increase in safety flags
```
sofia: thresholds: risk_index > 0.025 -> auto-fallback; 0.0125 < risk_index <= 0.025 -> paging alert; else green. additionally: rerank_precision_drop > 1.0pp on rerank-slice -> immediate rollback (hard fail).
tim: add a time dimension: require violations to be sustained for 3 consecutive 1m buckets or 5m sliding median > threshold before autofallback. prevents noise flips.
maya: rollout plan: 2h shadow, then 1% traffic with seeded cohorts (long-docs, low-resource-langs, incorrect-entity). If shadows look ok -> 10% observe -> 50% hold for 24h -> promote. Auto-fallback stays armed at all times.
deploy-bot: start: shadow run for rwdv8-quant4v2 @1706004330.
eval-bot: quick shadow reports (1000 samples): MRR_pct_change = -0.25%, safety_alert_rate_delta = +0.2pp, p95_latency +8ms; risk_index ~= 0.011 -> green. rerank_precision on rerank-slice: -0.9pp (below hard fail).
eric: good. please keep the rerank diff artifacts and candidate traces linked in the rollout record. we want per-request diffability for triage.
sofia: running a contrastive adversarial set now (edge-prompts). will post CSV of mismatches. also adding an oracle-run where we compare candidate and baseline outputs for hallucination counts.
oncall: FYI if risk_index moves into paging range I'll be paged; keep noise filters tuned.
maya: ops note: autofallback action = route all traffic to pinned stable (rwdv7-fp16) + create incident with reason tag like "risk_index:0.03|rerank:-1.3pp". we also emit a webhook with recent sample ids for quick replay.
eric: small ask: include model git sha and quantization metadata in the incident payload (quant bits, compiler flags). makes triage faster.
maya: on it. will also add a manual rollback slash command to the runbook: `/canary rollback <thread_ts>` which triggers fallback and documents reason.
deploy-bot: canary traffic=1% at 1706004400, variant=rwdv8-quant4v2. monitoring streams: longdoc-sample, low-lang-slice, rerank-edge.
eval-bot: 10k live-sampled requests in first 30m: aggregate risk_index = 0.009; rerank_precision_drop = -0.6pp; no sustained buckets above threshold.
maya: leaving risk_index alarm at 0.0125 (page) and 0.025 (auto-fallback). keep eyes on longdoc halluc counts and rare-entity failure modes.
eric: thanks. if we see rerank drift > 1pp for two consecutive 5m windows, perform immediate cut.
sofia: posting artifact links and the adversarial CSV in the design doc: https://go/internal/rwdv8/onboard-artifacts :link:. will summarize findings in 2h.
maya: awesome. team, please ack here when you've read the plan. :eyes:
